name: WhatsMarchy
author: Layitt / boyoyooo
description: WhatsApp notifications in the Omarchy bar, powered by wacli. The bar shows who is waiting and how many messages by default — message previews are opt-in. Click for previews, image/video/document opening, voice-note playback, and a quick reply — typed, or recorded as a voice note you listen back to before it sends.

barWidget.description: WhatsApp unread senders and counts, with a preview panel and quick text or voice-note reply (requires wacli)

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the local wacli database is checked for new messages. Nothing is fetched from WhatsApp — that is wacli sync's job.

schema.label: Display label
schema.description: Optional text shown in the panel header, useful if you run more than one WhatsApp account.

schema.label: What the bar shows
schema.description: Message text stays off the bar unless you opt into "Message preview" — every other setting shows only who is waiting and how many.

schema.label: Include WhatsApp Channels
schema.description: Off by default: channels are usually broadcast noise rather than messages addressed to you.

schema.label: Hide the widget when there is nothing new
